Mario Tennis Fever – Free Update Available Now – Nintendo Switch 2
A free update is available now in Mario Tennis Fever on the Nintendo Switch 2 system: https://ninten.do/6007v2DAR

Play on the brand-new Galaxy Court, use the Black Hole Racket to pull in opponents, and choose new color options for Luma. Plus, in the new Galaxy Court Match in Mix-It-Up mode, Prankster Comets can trigger various effects that can help you…or hinder you! GameShare via GameChat support has also been added! Share the tennis fun online with friends near and far who don't have the game.
